olivia_csm: Heads-up: VantageHealth onboarding flagged for potential renewal risk if latency doesn't stabilize. Customer expects 99.95% uptime and p95 < 200ms for generate routes. Need to confirm current metrics + reporting artifacts. cc @taylor_onboard @jamie_cs

jamie_cs: Noted. I pulled last 7 days — overall uptime 99.96% for hosted, but eu-west had a few short blips during peak. p95 generate is ~220ms global; eu-west p95 ~420ms (seen during 13:00-15:00 UTC).

taylor_onboard: Thanks — onboarding checklist item 'slo-signoff' is still pending. Do we have dashboards & an evidence bundle? Procurement asked for a short comms packet too.

devin_sre: I dug into the trace. On eu-west traffic we hit a fallback for ~6m due to capacity pressure. Key log excerpt: ```[2026-03-23T13:22:08Z] model-fallback: routed to rdx-small-v2; kv-cache-miss spike; batch-size auto->8; latency spike observed``` That matches the window with p95 jump. We have a temporary patch to bump reserved capacity for VantageHealth on dedicated pools.

bilal_support: If we move them to reserved capacity they'll want a cost estimate and the SLO credit implications. I have the credits template ready to populate — will DM once we settle the time window to exclude (if any).

olivia_csm: Action items: 1) devin — confirm patch ETA and whether fallback window can be excluded from SLO measurement for initial 72h onboarding (they requested). 2) jamie — prepare evidence bundle (uptime graph, p95 table, incident notes). 3) taylor — prep comms to procurement + cost delta for reserved capacity. 4) bilal — draft SLO credit calc; include proration. Can we aim for a customer-facing writeup by EOD? :pray:

devin_sre: Patch can be rolled in ~45m; will monitor and follow up with a short incident note. On exclusion: need Legal/Compliance sign-off before we carve out any window. Pinging @compliance-bot.

compliance-bot: Policy check: temporary SLO carve-outs for onboarding may be granted for up to 72 hours with CS + Legal sign-off. Please file case ID: ONB-2026-129 and include incident log, evidence bundle, and explicit customer acknowledgment.

olivia_csm: Filing ONB-2026-129 now and adding initial notes. I'll also drop the first draft of the customer writeup in #customer-docs and link it here. Appreciate the quick turnaround — moving this off the renewal-risk tracker after we have the writeup. :white_check_mark:
